definitions.explanation: Half of a circle, or a shape resembling one. Used both as a geometric term and in everyday description of curved shapes and arrangements.

examples.english: I cut the paper into a semicircle.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{半円|はんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The children lined up in a half circle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な{半円|はんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いて→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかっていた→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The rainbow hung in the sky, tracing a beautiful semicircle.

notes:
⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (circle). The same ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ gives ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧ (half) and ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧ (half a year).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半円|はんえん}{形|けい}: semicircular in shape
- {半円|はんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to trace a semicircle
- {半円|はんえん}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to be arranged in a half circle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: circle — the full shape
- ⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧: radius — a measurement, not a shape; ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ here means half the diameter
